run.subject: D-001
run.final_text:
Steps 1–9 are done and the draft schedule WS-R001 is recorded (case K-R001). I've stopped at step 10, which is yours: second review and sign-off.

# Hand-over note: D-001, Atlas Growth Fund I LP

Record date 30 October 2026, payment date 16 November 2026, USD. Both dates are still in the future, so everything below is as the sources stand today (6 October 2026).

## Totals

| Component | Gross | Tax withheld | Net |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-001-A, US-source dividend from Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003) | 10,000,000.00 | 1,510,562.50 | 8,489,437.50 |
| D-001-B, return of capital | 2,000,000.00 | 0.00 | 2,000,000.00 |
| **Total** | **12,000,000.00** | **1,510,562.50** | **10,489,437.50** |

The schedule has 30 determinations: 15 recipients across 2 components. All rates come from rule versions R-01, R-02 and R-03, version 2026.1, in force on the payment date.

## Lines not cleared on D-001-A

| Recipient | Gross | Outcome | Why | What would cure it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I-006 Meridian Holdings I S.à r.l. | 300,000 | Default 30%, tax 90,000 | Clearance CL-006 has open change case K-006, so the treaty rule is recorded as undetermined (A-R014). Its treaty claim rests on ownership, and since 1 August 2026 it and Meridian Holdings II (I-018) each hold 30% of the other; a Jersey trust holds 70% of each. | Close K-006 with a resolved ownership analysis, a new W-8BEN-E reflecting current ownership, and a renewed clearance. |
| I-014 Client account 7731, behind Sterling Nominees (I-007) | 225,000 | Default 30%, tax 67,500 | No tax certification and no recorded tax residence for the owner of 37.5% of the nominee's line (open item MF-001 on CL-007). | A valid W-8 or W-9 for the owner, passed on by the nominee before the payment date. |
| I-015 Bertrange Capital S.A. | 500,000 | Default 30%, tax 150,000 | Form F-015 ended 31 December 2025 and clearance CL-015W was withdrawn on 1 January 2026. | A new W-8BEN-E and a new clearance before 16 November 2026. |

- **I-006 needs your decision.** I did not resolve the circular holding. If the treaty rate were restored, the tax would be 45,000 instead of 90,000.
- **Default rather than hold.** The fund's limited partnership agreement (DOC-0001) is indexed but not digitised, so I could not read whether the terms allow a hold. All three lines are therefore on the default rate.
- **US persons.** I-016 Atlas Co-Invest Vehicle LP (300,000) and I-017 Atlas GP LLC (401,250) are certified by W-9 and paid gross.
- **Return of capital.** All 15 lines on D-001-B are not subject to withholding, rate 0.

## Cleared lines worth a second look

- **I-003 Kirchberg Industries, 5%.** Its effective voting holding in Orion is exactly 10.0%, which meets the inclusive 10% threshold. This is the only qualifying-holding rate on the schedule.
- **I-004 Limpertsberg Holdings, 15%.** Its effective voting holding is 9.99%, just under the threshold; I did not round it up. The difference is 124,875 of tax.
- **I-005 Grund Participations, 15%.** It holds 10.4% economic but only 8.0% voting, and the threshold is tested on voting.
- **I-012 Claire Dumont (FR) and I-009 Alpha Holdings SA (CH), cleared at 30%.** Both have valid forms with no treaty claim, and the rulebook has no treaty rule for either residence. I recorded these as cleared at a documented statutory rate, not as default; change that if you read the outcomes differently.
- **I-013 Echternach Pension Fund, 15%.** It relies on CL-007, which is admitted with open items; the open item concerns only I-014's share.

## Where sources disagree or are unknown

- **I-016's holding in the fund.** The investor register (system of record) says 3.0%; entity management (H-006) says 3.5%. I used the register, and the treasury line of 300,000 matches 3.0%.
- **Two investors named Alpha Holdings SA.** I-008 is the Luxembourg company (B 214 577) at the 15% treaty rate; I-009 is the Swiss company (CHE-318.442.907) at 30%. They were matched on LEI, not name.
- **F-015 status flag.** The onboarding system still shows it as VALIDATED although it has expired; validity was tested on dates.
- **Record date not yet reached.** The investor list is as the register stands today for 30 October, not a true freeze. The Orion dividend payments P-007 and P-008 are dated 9 and 12 October, also still ahead. Re-run before sign-off if anything changes.
- **Ontology gaps.** Treaty country and limitation-on-benefits have no ontology term; I read them from the certification rows as the computation returns them.
- **Rules not verified.** The rulebook notes that the rules are illustrative and have not been checked against the primary text.
- **Other upstream income.** A EUR 3,000,000 dividend from Borealis Logistik GmbH reached the fund on 25 September. It is not part of D-001 according to the distribution notice (DOC-0201).

steps.executed:
WITH dist AS (
    SELECT d.record_dt, d.pay_dt, f.fund_code
    FROM treasury.distribution d
    JOIN treasury.counterparty cp ON cp.cp_id = d.fund_cp
    JOIN investor_register.fund f ON f.lei = cp.lei
    WHERE d.dist_id = %(distribution_id)s
), intermediary AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.inv_no
    FROM onboarding.tax_form t, dist
    WHERE t.is_intermediary = 'Y' AND t.form_status <> 'SUPERSEDED'
      AND t.signed_dt <= dist.pay_dt AND (t.valid_to IS NULL OR t.valid_to >= dist.pay_dt)
), payee AS (
    SELECT c.inv_no, c.commit_id, i.lei, c.inv_no IN (SELECT inv_no FROM intermediary) AS looked_through
    FROM dist
    JOIN investor_register.commitment c ON c.fund_code = dist.fund_code
         AND c.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (c.to_dt IS NULL OR c.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
    JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.inv_no = c.inv_no
), recipient AS (
    SELECT p.inv_no AS investor_no, p.inv_no AS recipient_no, 100::numeric AS share_pct, 'own account' AS basis,
           'investor_register.commitment:' || p.commit_id AS source_ref
    FROM payee p WHERE NOT p.looked_through
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.inv_no, c.inv_no, c.unit_pct, 'investor in a flow-through fund vehicle',
           'investor_register.commitment:' || c.commit_id
    FROM payee p
    JOIN investor_register.fund f ON f.lei = p.lei
    JOIN investor_register.commitment c ON c.fund_code = f.fund_code
    CROSS JOIN dist
    WHERE p.looked_through AND c.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (c.to_dt IS NULL OR c.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.inv_no, o.owner_inv_no, o.pct_econ, 'beneficial owner behind a nominee',
           'onboarding.declared_owner:' || o.decl_id
    FROM payee p
    JOIN onboarding.declared_owner o ON o.owned_inv_no = p.inv_no AND o.alloc_basis = 'NOMINEE_ALLOC'
    CROSS JOIN dist
    WHERE p.looked_through AND o.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (o.to_dt IS NULL OR o.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
)
SELECT r.investor_no, r.recipient_no, i.display_name AS recipient_name, r.share_pct, r.basis,
       r.recipient_no IN (SELECT inv_no FROM intermediary) AS recipient_is_intermediary, r.source_ref
FROM recipient r JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.inv_no = r.recipient_no
ORDER BY r.investor_no, r.recipient_no

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT c.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.clearance_of ORDER BY c.decided_on DESC, c.valid_from DESC) AS position
    FROM clearance.clearance c
    WHERE c.in_context_of = %(fund_code)s AND c.decided_on <= %(on_date)s::date AND c.valid_from <= %(on_date)s::date
)
SELECT l.clearance_id AS clearance, l.clearance_of AS party_no, l.clearance_status, l.decided_on, l.valid_from, l.valid_to,
       (l.clearance_status IN ('cleared', 'admittedWithOpenItems')
        AND (l.valid_to IS NULL OR l.valid_to >= %(on_date)s::date)) AS in_force_on_date,
       l.default_treatment,
       (SELECT array_agg(m.finding_id || ' (' || m.unmet_requirement || '): ' || m.description ORDER BY m.finding_id)
        FROM clearance.missing_fact_finding m WHERE m.clearance_id = l.clearance_id) AS open_items,
       (SELECT array_agg(k.case_id || ': ' || e.description ORDER BY k.case_id)
        FROM clearance.case k LEFT JOIN clearance.change_event e ON e.change_id = k.triggered_by
        WHERE k.concerns_party = l.clearance_of AND k.case_kind = 'change'
          AND k.opened_on <= %(on_date)s::date AND (k.closed_on IS NULL OR k.closed_on > %(on_date)s::date)) AS open_change_cases,
       (SELECT array_agg(r.source_ref ORDER BY r.source_ref) FROM clearance.clearance_reliance r
        WHERE r.clearance_id = l.clearance_id) AS relies_on,
       'clearance.clearance:' || l.clearance_id AS source_ref
FROM latest l
WHERE l.position = 1
ORDER BY l.clearance_of

result.label: Withholding Determination
result.definition: The treatment decided for one party and one distribution component: the outcome, the rate and its basis, the clearance relied on and the assessment that supports it.

result.label: Withholding Schedule
result.definition: The set of withholding determinations for a distribution, prepared, reviewed and signed off before payments are released. A corrected schedule is a new record.

result.label: holdingCapacity
result.definition: Whether the holder holds the interest for its own benefit or as nominee for others. Exposure is read from beneficial interests; the holder of record is read from nominee interests.

result.label: withholdingRate
result.definition: Rate of tax to withhold.

result.label: Agreement
result.definition: A contract or governing document, such as a limited partnership agreement or shareholders' agreement.

result.label: Beneficial Owner
result.definition: A party that holds at least one ownership interest for its own benefit, so that the income from it is its own. Membership follows from the interests held and is not asserted.

result.label: Obligation
result.definition: A reporting or withholding duty of a party, based on a rule version. Recorded separately from the assessment that identifies it.

result.label: Ownership Interest
result.definition: A holding by one party in one legal entity, with its own percentages, share class, validity period, governing agreement and evidence.

result.label: termStatus
result.definition: Where a term stands in its lifecycle: proposed, reviewed or released.

result.label: caseOutcome
result.definition: Outcome of the case in the terms of its operating procedure.

result.label: identifier

result.label: Ownership Interest

result.label: Role Assignment

result.label: Agreement

result.text:
Steps 1–9 are done and the draft schedule WS-R001 is recorded (case K-R001). I've stopped at step 10, which is yours: second review and sign-off.

# Hand-over note: D-001, Atlas Growth Fund I LP

Record date 30 October 2026, payment date 16 November 2026, USD. Both dates are still in the future, so everything below is as the sources stand today (6 October 2026).

## Totals

| Component | Gross | Tax withheld | Net |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-001-A, US-source dividend from Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003) | 10,000,000.00 | 1,510,562.50 | 8,489,437.50 |
| D-001-B, return of capital | 2,000,000.00 | 0.00 | 2,000,000.00 |
| **Total** | **12,000,000.00** | **1,510,562.50** | **10,489,437.50** |

The schedule has 30 determinations: 15 recipients across 2 components. All rates come from rule versions R-01, R-02 and R-03, version 2026.1, in force on the payment date.

## Lines not cleared on D-001-A

| Recipient | Gross | Outcome | Why | What would cure it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I-006 Meridian Holdings I S.à r.l. | 300,000 | Default 30%, tax 90,000 | Clearance CL-006 has open change case K-006, so the treaty rule is recorded as undetermined (A-R014). Its treaty claim rests on ownership, and since 1 August 2026 it and Meridian Holdings II (I-018) each hold 30% of the other; a Jersey trust holds 70% of each. | Close K-006 with a resolved ownership analysis, a new W-8BEN-E reflecting current ownership, and a renewed clearance. |
| I-014 Client account 7731, behind Sterling Nominees (I-007) | 225,000 | Default 30%, tax 67,500 | No tax certification and no recorded tax residence for the owner of 37.5% of the nominee's line (open item MF-001 on CL-007). | A valid W-8 or W-9 for the owner, passed on by the nominee before the payment date. |
| I-015 Bertrange Capital S.A. | 500,000 | Default 30%, tax 150,000 | Form F-015 ended 31 December 2025 and clearance CL-015W was withdrawn on 1 January 2026. | A new W-8BEN-E and a new clearance before 16 November 2026. |

- **I-006 needs your decision.** I did not resolve the circular holding. If the treaty rate were restored, the tax would be 45,000 instead of 90,000.
- **Default rather than hold.** The fund's limited partnership agreement (DOC-0001) is indexed but not digitised, so I could not read whether the terms allow a hold. All three lines are therefore on the default rate.
- **US persons.** I-016 Atlas Co-Invest Vehicle LP (300,000) and I-017 Atlas GP LLC (401,250) are certified by W-9 and paid gross.
- **Return of capital.** All 15 lines on D-001-B are not subject to withholding, rate 0.

## Cleared lines worth a second look

- **I-003 Kirchberg Industries, 5%.** Its effective voting holding in Orion is exactly 10.0%, which meets the inclusive 10% threshold. This is the only qualifying-holding rate on the schedule.
- **I-004 Limpertsberg Holdings, 15%.** Its effective voting holding is 9.99%, just under the threshold; I did not round it up. The difference is 124,875 of tax.
- **I-005 Grund Participations, 15%.** It holds 10.4% economic but only 8.0% voting, and the threshold is tested on voting.
- **I-012 Claire Dumont (FR) and I-009 Alpha Holdings SA (CH), cleared at 30%.** Both have valid forms with no treaty claim, and the rulebook has no treaty rule for either residence. I recorded these as cleared at a documented statutory rate, not as default; change that if you read the outcomes differently.
- **I-013 Echternach Pension Fund, 15%.** It relies on CL-007, which is admitted with open items; the open item concerns only I-014's share.

## Where sources disagree or are unknown

- **I-016's holding in the fund.** The investor register (system of record) says 3.0%; entity management (H-006) says 3.5%. I used the register, and the treasury line of 300,000 matches 3.0%.
- **Two investors named Alpha Holdings SA.** I-008 is the Luxembourg company (B 214 577) at the 15% treaty rate; I-009 is the Swiss company (CHE-318.442.907) at 30%. They were matched on LEI, not name.
- **F-015 status flag.** The onboarding system still shows it as VALIDATED although it has expired; validity was tested on dates.
- **Record date not yet reached.** The investor list is as the register stands today for 30 October, not a true freeze. The Orion dividend payments P-007 and P-008 are dated 9 and 12 October, also still ahead. Re-run before sign-off if anything changes.
- **Ontology gaps.** Treaty country and limitation-on-benefits have no ontology term; I read them from the certification rows as the computation returns them.
- **Rules not verified.** The rulebook notes that the rules are illustrative and have not been checked against the primary text.
- **Other upstream income.** A EUR 3,000,000 dividend from Borealis Logistik GmbH reached the fund on 25 September. It is not part of D-001 according to the distribution notice (DOC-0201).
